query: UPDATE whatsapp_linked_account SET state=$4,authorization_generation=authorization_generation+CASE WHEN $4='reconnect' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1 AND authorization_generation=$2 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM whatsapp_session_owner WHERE account_id=$1 AND epoch=$3) AND identity_jid IS NOT NULL
